summary.hpi_narrative: Lakshmi Devi is a 65-year-old female presenting with a 2-day history of chest discomfort. The onset was sudden, and the severity is reported as severe. The discomfort is described as a burning pressure located in the centre of the chest behind the breastbone. It is associated with shortness of breath.
